name: Throgg, King of Trolls
canonNotes: A Troll King who, unusually, has a cunning mind and a taste for civilised things, ruling Troll Country with unstable brilliance.
His mutations gave him intelligence, but his hunger never fades.
voiceNotes: Surprisingly articulate yet brutish and hungry; mixes cunning with slobber.
Mocks the weak, eats the defeated.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
